notice: Natural-language iot-ai is the primary surface. Advanced engines remain separately testable but are automatically composed by the closed loop.

public_skills.purpose: Conversation-aware closed-loop engineering through Tasks, Meetings, Multi-Coder, tests, repair and audit.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai finish all critical PMD tasks and keep working until terminal

public_skills.purpose: Authoritative task lifecycle, validation, WIP waves, evidence and Founder handoff.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-tasks continue and finish the remaining tasks

public_skills.purpose: Automatic planning, failure-analysis and hard-judge meetings.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-meeting deeply review the selected task with all eligible seats

public_skills.purpose: Role-bound implementation, deterministic tests, repair and independent final review.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-multi-coder implement the approved task and verify it fully

public_skills.purpose: Translate natural outcomes into visible intent and explain advanced controls only when needed.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-help how do I finish the remaining tasks?

public_skills.purpose: Management view of tasks, waves, meetings, providers, evidence and next actors.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-status what is finished and what is blocked?

public_skills.purpose: Natural-language orchestration, privacy, WIP and provider policy settings.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-settings use strongest available models and four critical tasks per wave

public_skills.purpose: Transactional package discovery, install, verify, rollback and fleet receipts.
public_skills.example: /iot-ai-update install the latest verified private delivery on authorised hosts
